hunks.baseline: Regardless of its type or purpose, there were two main conditions for bringing a spell’s power to its limit.
hunks.sol: Whatever its type or purpose, two things could bring a spell’s power to its limit.

hunks.baseline: First: the caster’s immense mana.
hunks.sol: First, the caster’s immense mana.

hunks.baseline: Second: a magic circle capable of gathering and releasing that mana with the greatest efficiency.
hunks.sol: Second, a Magic Formation that could gather and release that mana as efficiently as possible.

hunks.baseline: That was why the magic wielded by the woman known as the Grand Magecould only be utterly perfect.
hunks.sol: The magic wielded by the woman known as the Grand Mage had both. It could hardly have been more perfect.

hunks.baseline: Just as a masterwork sword was born after countless rounds of hammering and quenching, magic, too, could reach its greatest power when enough time and effort were devoted to it.
hunks.sol: Just as a masterwork sword was forged through countless rounds of hammering and quenching, a spell could reach its greatest power when given enough time and care.

hunks.baseline: While the hillside below was turning red with blood, the spell circle that had already been completed began to activate. No one could stop it. And Jin Taekyung wasn’t the only one who had some idea of the power contained in that enormous sphere of flame.
hunks.sol: The Magic Formation had been completed while the hillside below turned red with blood. Once it activated, no one could stop it. And Jin Taekyung wasn’t the only one who had some idea how powerful that enormous sphere of flame would be.

hunks.baseline: The shadow of the flames, having swallowed the wind and moisture all around, stretched over part of the battlefield. Fire King Jeok Cheongang watched it descend with stunned eyes.
hunks.sol: It swallowed the wind and moisture around it, and the shadow of its flames spread over part of the battlefield. Fire King Jeok Cheongang watched it descend, stunned.

hunks.baseline: He also knew that, at this very moment, he was the only one left who could stop that powerful explosion.
hunks.sol: He also knew that, at this moment, he was the only one left who could stop that terrible power from exploding.

hunks.baseline: Flames burst from his toes as he shot forward at the speed of a flash.
hunks.sol: Flames burst from beneath his toes, and he shot forward like a flash of light.

hunks.baseline: But as Jeok Cheongang charged toward the fireball with the Flamefire Path, a chilling whistle rang out behind him. He had to duck in a hurry.
hunks.sol: But as Jeok Cheongang raced toward the fireball along the Flamefire Path, a chilling whistle sounded behind him. He ducked.

hunks.baseline: Like a skilled butcher slicing meat, a streak of dark-red Force skimmed past Jeok Cheongang’s head, slicing off a thin layer of hair and skin before cutting through the air.
hunks.sol: A streak of dark-red Force skimmed his head, shaving away a thin layer of hair and skin as neatly as a skilled butcher slicing meat, then cut through the air beyond him.

hunks.baseline: His toes shifted for the briefest instant as he dodged. By then, the butcher of a man had appeared in front of him at a speed beyond Shifting Form and Position. Jeok Cheongang bit his lip.
hunks.sol: His footing had wavered for the instant it took to dodge. By then, that butcher of a man had appeared in front of him at a speed surpassing Shifting Form and Position. Jeok Cheongang bit his lip.

hunks.baseline: “How dare I? After ending up in that state, you still don’t get it?”
hunks.sol: “How dare I? Even in that state, you still haven’t figured it out?”

hunks.baseline: Unlike Jeok Cheongang, who was covered in blood after their fierce battle, he’d suffered only a few minor wounds. Now he was utterly certain.
hunks.sol: Unlike Jeok Cheongang, who was covered in blood after their fierce battle, he had suffered only a few minor wounds. Now he was certain of the difference in their strength.

hunks.baseline: Of their obvious difference in strength.
Of his own advantage.
hunks.sol: Certain of his advantage.

hunks.baseline: “You can’t stop it. Nothing.”
hunks.sol: “You can’t stop anything.”

hunks.baseline: His sword turned hazy like a heat shimmer and rushed in, tearing through the wind.
hunks.sol: His sword blurred like a heat shimmer and came at Jeok Cheongang, tearing through the wind.

hunks.baseline: Force surged up like a giant wave, striking and shattering everything around them.
hunks.sol: Enormous surges of Force lashed out and exploded in every direction.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang barely dodged the attacks raining down on him, not even taking time to catch his breath. His eyes grew still.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang barely dodged the attacks pouring down on him, forgetting even to breathe. His gaze grew still.

hunks.baseline: If he’d possessed nothing but a fiery temper, his title of Fire King might already have been erased from the world.
hunks.sol: If all he’d had was a fiery temper, the title of Fire King might have vanished from the world long ago.

hunks.baseline: But Jeok Cheongang had survived this long amid the mountain of sabers and forest of swords that was the Murim, and even at a moment like this, with life and death hanging in the balance, he faced reality with a cool head.
hunks.sol: But Jeok Cheongang had survived this long in Murim’s mountain of sabers and forest of swords. Even now, with his life hanging in the balance, he faced reality with a cool head.

hunks.baseline: There was only one way past the Blood-Sword Demon Lord blocking his path—and one way to stop the terrible calamity that had yet to reach the ground.
hunks.sol: And he could see the one way past the Blood-Sword Demon Lord, the one way to stop the terrible calamity before it reached the ground.

hunks.baseline: The final dance of a fire demon, performed with death already accepted.
hunks.sol: The final dance of a fire demon prepared to die.

hunks.baseline: The beginning and end of the Fire Gate Clan. The fiercest blaze—and the final ashes.
hunks.sol: The beginning and end of the Fire Gate Clan. Its fiercest blaze and its final ashes.

hunks.baseline: There was no flame in this world that burned forever. When the dance ended, the heat would fade and his body would burn to ash.
hunks.sol: No flame burned forever. When the dance ended, its heat would fade and his body would burn away.

hunks.baseline: The more powerful the spark within, the greater its blaze. And to endure that growing fire, one had to throw ever more of one’s life into it as kindling.
hunks.sol: The stronger the spark within him, the greater the power of the blaze. And to sustain that growing fire, he would have to feed it more of his own life.

hunks.baseline: This body, holding more Scorching Yang Qi than ever before, wouldn’t survive it this time.
hunks.sol: His body held more Scorching Yang Qi than ever before. This time, it would not survive.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang murmured to himself and twisted his body. He evaded the dense net of Force covering every direction and drew up every last bit of energy he possessed.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang murmured the words to himself and twisted his body. Slipping through the dense net of Force surrounding him, he drew up every last bit of energy he possessed.

hunks.baseline: The Scorching Yang Qi he’d accumulated over countless years—several *jiazi*’ worth.
hunks.sol: The Scorching Yang Qi he had accumulated over countless years—several *jiazi*’ worth.

hunks.baseline: And at last, he awoke the innate qi sleeping deep inside his body, a forbidden realm for martial artists.
hunks.sol: And at last, he awakened the innate qi sleeping deep inside him, a source of power martial artists dared not touch.

hunks.baseline: At that very moment, a massive jet-black Force came flying from somewhere and blocked the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.
hunks.sol: At that very moment, a massive surge of ink-black Force came flying from somewhere and blocked the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.

hunks.baseline: A thunderous crash sent the air around them into turmoil.
hunks.sol: A thunderous crash shook the surrounding air.

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord emerged, parting the cloud of dust that was about to rise in an instant. He recognized the intruder and frowned.
hunks.sol: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord emerged through the dust before it could billow up, recognized the intruder, and frowned.

hunks.baseline: “…Why are you here?”
hunks.sol: “…What are you doing here?”

hunks.baseline: The dry words slipped between his firmly closed lips.
hunks.sol: The dry words slipped between firmly closed lips.

hunks.baseline: The intruder—no, Black Night King Sima Gong—kept his eyes fixed on the Blood-Sword Demon Lord as he calmly added, addressing Jeok Cheongang behind him,
hunks.sol: The intruder—no, Black Night King Sima Gong—kept his eyes on the Blood-Sword Demon Lord as he spoke calmly to Jeok Cheongang behind him.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s eyes widened at this unexpected appearance.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: Sima Gong—the man he’d thought was a traitor.
hunks.sol: Sima Gong was the man he’d thought a traitor.

hunks.baseline: There was so much he wanted to ask him, so much he wanted to say.
hunks.sol: There was much he wanted to ask him, and much he wanted to say.

hunks.baseline: But Jeok Cheongang had almost no time. He put all of it aside and sprang forward again, leaving only a short Sound Transmission behind.
hunks.sol: But he had almost no time. Jeok Cheongang put it all aside and sprang forward again, leaving only a brief Sound Transmission behind.

hunks.baseline: Only the wind that tore across his whole body as he followed the Flamefire Path, and the terrifying crashes and shouts that rang out through it.
hunks.sol: Only the wind tearing across his body as he followed the Flamefire Path, and the terrifying crashes and shouts that rang through it.

hunks.baseline: The air around them shook. That was all.
hunks.sol: The air shook. That was all.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang realized that Sima Gong had barely blocked the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s Force from behind him. Gritting his teeth, he pushed himself to go faster.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang knew Sima Gong had barely intercepted the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s Force as it came at him from behind. Gritting his teeth, he drove himself faster.

hunks.baseline: A few moments.
hunks.sol: Moments.

hunks.baseline: He might lose his life in only a few dozen exchanges.
hunks.sol: He might die within a few dozen exchanges.

hunks.baseline: A single finger’s breadth could decide life and death, and a gap of a split second—divided and divided again—could change one’s fate.
hunks.sol: A finger’s breadth could decide life and death. A gap measured in fractions of an instant could change a person’s fate.

hunks.baseline: That was the Murim. The world of superhumans.
hunks.sol: That was Murim. The world of superhumans.

hunks.baseline: But in that instant, Jeok Cheongang crossed dozens of *jang* in a single bound. Nothing could hold him back.
hunks.sol: But in that instant, Jeok Cheongang crossed dozens of *jang* in a single bound. He felt no limit holding him back.

hunks.baseline: If one chain bound him, it was time alone.
hunks.sol: Only time.

hunks.baseline: His body shot forward in an explosion of speed, heading straight for the enormous sphere of flame.
hunks.sol: His body shot forward faster than ever, hurtling toward the enormous sphere of flame.

hunks.baseline: It was less than one *jang* away from the ground now, a terrible blaze spreading over everyone’s heads.
hunks.sol: It hung less than one *jang* above the ground now, its terrible blaze spreading over everyone’s heads.

hunks.baseline: But no matter how desperately he wished otherwise, reality followed its cruel course.
hunks.sol: But no matter how desperately he wished otherwise, events followed their cruel course.

hunks.baseline: Even from more than twenty *jang* away, it was hard to breathe.
hunks.sol: Even from more than twenty *jang* away, he could barely breathe.

hunks.baseline: Watching the flames swell at last before they touched the ground, Jeok Cheongang suddenly thought:
hunks.sol: As the flames swelled just before touching the ground, Jeok Cheongang found himself thinking:

hunks.baseline: If only he’d been a dozen *jang* closer to it.
hunks.sol: If only he’d been a dozen *jang* closer.

hunks.baseline: If only someone other than Jeok Cheongang or Jin Taekyung were here—someone who could stop the calamity.
hunks.sol: If only someone other than him or Jin Taekyung were here. Someone who could stop this calamity.

hunks.baseline: It was already too late to stop this enormous explosion.
hunks.sol: It was already too late to stop the enormous explosion.

hunks.baseline: But he still had to move.
hunks.sol: But he had to keep going.

hunks.baseline: He belonged to neither the righteous path, the unorthodox factions, nor the Demonic Path—but this was the path he’d chosen.

hunks.baseline: And heard it, too.

hunks.baseline: Just as the white light-flames of the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist shot out in an explosion, a dazzling streak of light shone across the dark sky ahead of it, cutting through space.
hunks.sol: Just as the white light-flames of the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist shot out, dazzling streaks of light raced ahead of them across the dark sky.

hunks.baseline: Those brilliant bolts plunged into the enormous, swelling sphere of flame.
hunks.sol: Brilliant bolts plunged into the enormous, swelling sphere of flame.

hunks.baseline: In a world that seemed frozen, a distant flash of light and fire blended together, turning everyone’s vision white.
hunks.sol: In a world that seemed to have stopped, light and fire mingled in a distant flash that turned everyone’s vision white.

hunks.baseline: Instead of the world everyone knew, a new world made of light opened up.
hunks.sol: The world everyone knew gave way to a new world made of light.

hunks.baseline: *Could this be…?*
hunks.sol: *Could that have been…?*

hunks.baseline: Before Jin Taekyung could fully recall the unbelievable sight he’d seen at the last moment, he felt his vision, which had been washed in blinding light, slowly return.
hunks.sol: Before Jin Taekyung could fully recall the unbelievable sight he’d seen at the last moment, he felt his vision slowly return.

hunks.baseline: The blinding white flash that had obscured everyone’s vision faded. What filled the space it left behind was a tremendous roar that came belatedly, and flames surging up across the battlefield.
hunks.sol: The white flash that had blinded everyone faded. In its place came a tremendous roar, arriving late, and flames surging up across the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: Would this be what it looked like if the sun in the sky rained down?
hunks.sol: Was this what it would look like if the sun rained down from the sky?

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of fireballs, great and small, fell over a radius of more than a hundred *jang*.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of fireballs, great and small, fell across a radius of more than a hundred *jang*.

hunks.baseline: Just as its name suggested, Hell Fire—like the flames of death.
hunks.sol: Like flames of death—true to the name Hell Fire.

hunks.baseline: But death did not treat everyone on the battlefield equally.
hunks.sol: But death did not fall equally on everyone on the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: The groan that suddenly slipped between someone’s lips didn’t belong to Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: The groan that escaped someone’s lips did not belong to Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: The Grand Mage silently gazed at the hellscape spread out below the hill.
hunks.sol: The Grand Mage gazed silently at the inferno below the hill.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, she was watching the Dark Heaven cultists collapse into charred lumps, unable even to scream.
hunks.sol: More precisely, at the Dark Heaven cultists collapsing into charred lumps without even a chance to scream.

hunks.baseline: She felt no sorrow at the sight of her allies meeting such a horrible death.
hunks.sol: She felt no sorrow at the sight of her allies dying so horribly.

hunks.baseline: Only pure confusion.
hunks.sol: Only bewilderment.

hunks.baseline: Why had the fireball that should have exploded in the midst of the enemy’s forces broken into pieces and swept through her own allies instead?
hunks.sol: Why had the fireball that should have exploded in the midst of the enemy broken apart and swept through her own forces instead?

hunks.baseline: Among the roughly thousands of casualties, why did the enemy number fewer than a hundred?
hunks.sol: Of the thousands of casualties, why did fewer than a hundred appear to be enemies?

hunks.baseline: Her mind was filled with nothing but questions. The Grand Mage had watched only Jeok Cheongang at the last moment, but someone else, who’d taken everything in, already knew the answer.
hunks.sol: Those questions filled her mind. She had watched only Jeok Cheongang in the final moments, but someone else had seen it all—and already knew the answer.

hunks.sol: The Grand Mage turned at the voice behind her and saw Jin Taekyung smiling, weakly but unmistakably.
